name: What is decorative millwork and how can it enhance my home's interior?

mainEntity.name: What is decorative millwork and how can it enhance my home's interior?

acceptedAnswer.text: Decorative millwork refers to custom-made or pre-fabricated wood elements used to enhance the aesthetic appeal of a home. This can include crown molding, baseboards, wainscoting, mantels, and door/window casings. It adds architectural detail and character, elevating the perceived value and design sophistication of a space. When considering millwork, a practical tradeoff is often balancing the intricate detail of custom work with the cost-effectiveness and quicker installation of pre-fabricated options. Custom millwork offers unique designs tailored to your home's style, while standard profiles provide a classic look efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Decorative millwork uses custom or pre-fabricated wood elements like molding and wainscoting to add architectural detail and enhance your home's interior.
